description: Generador de Residuos de Construcción y Demolición (RCD). Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente - SDA. Proyectos de infraestructura detallados en el perímetro urbano de Bogotá D.C., que son generadores de residuos de construcción y demolición (RCD). Identificándose volúmenes producidos de (RCD) por los diferentes proyectos constructivos. Resolución Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente 1115 de 2012. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente - SDA. Its tags are Disposición, Escombro, Residuo de construcción y demolición, Residuo sólido. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2025-12-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
